categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in manufacturing and sales of water heaters, kitchen appliances, and integrated kitchen systems. It also imports kitchen and household appliances and provides related services such as oil filter delivery, product safety inspections, and maintenance. The business segments include water heaters (26.3% revenue), kitchen appliances (32.6%), integrated kitchens (27.8%), and others (13.3%).
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages AI technology for smart kitchen products, including AI-controlled range hoods and gas stoves. It employs digital and automated manufacturing processes, such as AI automation and QR code management, to enhance production flexibility and quality. R&D focuses on energy efficiency, safety, and smart control systems integrating hardware and software innovations.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include domestic consumers, construction companies, chain specialty stores, and distributors. The company serves the residential housing market, especially new housing developments and renovation projects. It also targets international markets including China, Vietnam, North America, and other Asian countries through subsidiaries and brand licensing.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are primarily based in Taiwan with manufacturing plants and sales offices nationwide. The company has expanded overseas markets in China, Hong Kong, the United States, Canada, Vietnam, and Myanmar. Vietnam serves as a strategic base for ASEAN market expansion.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, manufacturing finished kitchen and water heating products and selling directly to retailers, construction projects, and end consumers. It also imports and distributes kitchen appliances, integrating upstream component sourcing with downstream sales and after-sales services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include AI-driven smart kitchen product innovation, digital transformation of manufacturing with intelligent automation, and expansion of integrated kitchen solutions. The company emphasizes sustainable development, energy efficiency, and enhancing customer experience through data-driven management and smart after-sales services. R&D focuses on smart gas stoves, AI range hoods, water purification, and embedded appliances.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of water heaters, kitchen appliances, integrated kitchens, and imported household appliances. The company also earns from after-sales services including maintenance and safety inspections. It operates a multi-channel sales model including direct retail, B2B sales to construction and distributors, and e-commerce.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a market leader in Taiwan’s gas appliance and integrated kitchen sectors, distinguished by its strong R&D capabilities, extensive sales network, and comprehensive after-sales service system. Competitors include local and international kitchen appliance manufacturers and importers. The company differentiates itself through innovation, brand reputation, and integrated solutions.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$9.6 billion in the latest fiscal year, reflecting a 16.06% year-over-year growth. Operating profit increased by 18.98%, and net profit attributable to the parent company grew by 21.31%. Total assets reached over NT$10.6 billion, with steady growth in equity and profitability ratios, indicating a stable and expanding financial profile.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes creating 'a lifetime of service' with a strong commitment to consumer satisfaction through innovative, energy-efficient, and smart kitchen products. Its unique value lies in offering one-stop integrated kitchen solutions combining design, manufacturing, and after-sales service. The AI Kitchen product line and the SAKURA i Care intelligent service platform enhance user convenience and brand loyalty, setting it apart from competitors.
